# Fixture provenance

- `matching_cases.json` contains originally authored synthetic matching cases.
- `matching_heldout.json` contains 68 originally authored fictional regression
  scenarios. Regenerate it with `python tests/fixtures/generate_matching_heldout.py`.
  Labels are defined by the scenarios before running the matcher. Its historical
  filename is retained for CLI compatibility; it is no longer a held-out
  benchmark of real employer listings. No real listing text is retained here.
- `synthetic-resume.pdf` is generated by `generate_synthetic_resume.py` using
  fictional candidate details and an example-domain address.
- `blank.pdf` is a minimal test document with no candidate information.
- The LaTeX fixtures retain their upstream MIT notices; see
  `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` at the repository root.

Replacing current files does not remove earlier copies from Git history, old
branches or pull-request references. Those need the separate publication
history cleanup. Do not add third-party UI reference screenshots to commits.
